entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:1
segments: ¶On my bed, in the nights, I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:2
segments: I will rise now, and go about the city; In the streets and in the broadways Will I seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:3
segments: The watchmen that go about the city found me: --Have ye seen him whom my soul loveth?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:4
segments: --Scarcely had I passed from them, When I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, Until I had brought him into my mother's house, And into the chamber of her that conceived me.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:5
segments: I charge you, daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles, or by the hinds of the field, That ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, till he please.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:6
segments: ¶Who is this, [she] that cometh up from the wilderness Like pillars of smoke, Perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, With all powders of the merchant? ...

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:7
segments: ¶Behold his couch, Solomon's own: Threescore mighty men are about it, Of the mighty of Israel.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:8
segments: They all hold the sword, Experts in war; Each hath his sword upon his thigh Because of alarm in the nights.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:9
segments: King Solomon made himself a palanquin Of the wood of Lebanon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:10
segments: Its pillars he made of silver, Its support of gold, Its seat of purple; The midst thereof was paved [with] love By the daughters of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 3:11
segments: Go forth, daughters of Zion, And behold king Solomon With the crown wherewith his mother crowned him In the day of his espousals, And in the day of the gladness of his heart.
